The ledger projection freshness bounds this gate. Semantic ambiguity routes to the authorized reasoning chat. Continuation retains safety, privacy, security, permission, spending, publication, irreversible-action and explicit owner-stop boundaries, including access. It expands neither scope nor strategy, applies no terminal machinery to a tiny task without a lock, and operationalizes rather than replaces task locks, the continuous-next-step rule, the worker supervision bootstrap and terminal comparator.
